paragraphs.text: translated by
1. Auspicious is the aspect of Vadhryasva's fire good is its guidance, pleasant are its visitings.
paragraphs.original: भद्रा अग्नेर्वध्र्यश्वस्य संदृशो वामी प्रणीतिः सुरणा उपेतयः ।
paragraphs.translit: bhadrā agnervadhryaśvasya saṃdṛśo vāmī praṇītiḥ suraṇā upetayaḥ |

paragraphs.text: When first the people Of Sumitra kindle it, with butter poured thereon it crackles and shines bright.
paragraphs.original: यदीं सुमित्रा विशो अग्र इन्धते घृतेनाहुतो जरते दविद्युतत्
paragraphs.translit: yadīṃ sumitrā viśo agra indhate ghṛtenāhuto jarate davidyutat

paragraphs.text: 2. Butter is that which makes Vadhryaiva's fire growstrong: the butter is its food, the butter makes it fat.
paragraphs.original: घृतमग्नेर्वध्र्यश्वस्य वर्धनं घृतमन्नं घृतम्वस्य मेदनम् ।
paragraphs.translit: ghṛtamagnervadhryaśvasya vardhanaṃ ghṛtamannaṃ ghṛtamvasya medanam |

paragraphs.text: It spreads abroad when butter hath been offered it, and balmed with streams of butter shines forth like the Sun.
paragraphs.original: घृतेनाहुत उर्विया वि पप्रथे सूर्य इव रोचते सर्पिरासुतिः
paragraphs.translit: ghṛtenāhuta urviyā vi paprathe sūrya iva rocate sarpirāsutiḥ

paragraphs.text: 3. Still newest is this face of thine, O Agni, which Manu and Sumitra have enkindled.
paragraphs.original: यत्ते मनुर्यदनीकं सुमित्रः समीधे अग्ने तदिदं नवीयः ।
paragraphs.translit: yatte manuryadanīkaṃ sumitraḥ samīdhe agne tadidaṃ navīyaḥ |

paragraphs.text: So richly shine, accept our songs with favour, so give us strengthening food, so send us glory.
paragraphs.original: स रेवच्छोच स गिरो जुषस्व स वाजं दर्षि स इह श्रवो धाः
paragraphs.translit: sa revacchoca sa giro juṣasva sa vājaṃ darṣi sa iha śravo dhāḥ

paragraphs.text: 4. Accept this offering, Agni, whom aforetime Vadhryasva, hath entreated and enkindled.
paragraphs.original: यं त्वा पूर्वमीळितो वध्र्यश्वः समीधे अग्ने स इदं जुषस्व ।
paragraphs.translit: yaṃ tvā pūrvamīḷito vadhryaśvaḥ samīdhe agne sa idaṃ juṣasva |

paragraphs.text: Guard well our homes and ople, guard our bodies, protect thy girt to us which thou hast granted.
paragraphs.original: स न स्तिपा उत भवा तनूपा दात्रं रक्षस्व यदिदं ते अस्मे
paragraphs.translit: sa na stipā uta bhavā tanūpā dātraṃ rakṣasva yadidaṃ te asme

paragraphs.text: 5. Be splendid, guard us Kinsman of Vadhryasva: let not the enmity of men o'ercome thee,
paragraphs.original: भवा द्युम्नी वाध्र्यश्वोत गोपा मा त्वा तारीदभिमातिर्जनानाम् ।
paragraphs.translit: bhavā dyumnī vādhryaśvota gopā mā tvā tārīdabhimātirjanānām |

paragraphs.text: Like the bold hero Cyavana, I Sumitra tell forth the title of Vadhryaiva's Kinsman.
paragraphs.original: शूर इव धृष्णुश्च्यवनः सुमित्रः प्र नु वोचं वाध्र्यश्वस्य नाम
paragraphs.translit: śūra iva dhṛṣṇuścyavanaḥ sumitraḥ pra nu vocaṃ vādhryaśvasya nāma

paragraphs.text: 6. All treasures hast thou won, of plains and mountains, and quelled the Dasas' and Aryas' hatred.
paragraphs.original: समज्र्या पर्वत्या वसूनि दासा वृत्राण्यार्या जिगेथ ।
paragraphs.translit: samajryā parvatyā vasūni dāsā vṛtrāṇyāryā jigetha |

paragraphs.text: Like the bold hero Cyavana, O Agni, mayst thou subdue the men who long for battle.
paragraphs.original: शूर इव धृष्णुश्च्यवनो जनानां त्वमग्ने पृतनायूँरभि ष्याः
paragraphs.translit: śūra iva dhṛṣṇuścyavano janānāṃ tvamagne pṛtanāyūm̐rabhi ṣyāḥ

paragraphs.text: 7. Deft Agni hath a lengthened thread, tall oxen, a thousand heifers, numberless devices.
paragraphs.original: दीर्घतन्तुर्बृहदुक्षायमग्निः सहस्रस्तरीः शतनीथ ऋभ्वा ।
paragraphs.translit: dīrghatanturbṛhadukṣāyamagniḥ sahasrastarīḥ śatanītha ṛbhvā |

paragraphs.text: Decked by the men, splendid among the splendid, shine brightly forth amid devout Sumitras.
paragraphs.original: द्युमान्द्युमत्सु नृभिर्मृज्यमानः सुमित्रेषु दीदयो देवयत्सु
paragraphs.translit: dyumāndyumatsu nṛbhirmṛjyamānaḥ sumitreṣu dīdayo devayatsu

paragraphs.text: 8. Thine is the teeming cow, O Jatavedas, who pours at once her ceaseless flow, Sabardhuk,
paragraphs.original: त्वे धेनुः सुदुघा जातवेदोऽसश्चतेव समना सबर्धुक् ।
paragraphs.translit: tve dhenuḥ sudughā jātavedo'saścateva samanā sabardhuk |

paragraphs.text: Thou. art lit up by men enriched with guerdon, O Agni, by the pious-souled Sumitras.
paragraphs.original: त्वं नृभिर्दक्षिणावद्भिरग्ने सुमित्रेभिरिध्यसे देवयद्भिः
paragraphs.translit: tvaṃ nṛbhirdakṣiṇāvadbhiragne sumitrebhiridhyase devayadbhiḥ

paragraphs.text: 9. Even Immortal Gods, O Jatavedas, Vadhryasva's Kinsman, have declared thy grandeur.
paragraphs.original: देवाश्चित्ते अमृता जातवेदो महिमानं वाध्र्यश्व प्र वोचन् ।
paragraphs.translit: devāścitte amṛtā jātavedo mahimānaṃ vādhryaśva pra vocan |

paragraphs.text: When human tribes drew near with supplication thou conqueredst with men whom thou hadst strengthened.
paragraphs.original: यत्सम्पृच्छं मानुषीर्विश आयन्त्वं नृभिरजयस्त्वावृधेभिः
paragraphs.translit: yatsampṛcchaṃ mānuṣīrviśa āyantvaṃ nṛbhirajayastvāvṛdhebhiḥ

paragraphs.text: 10. Like as a father bears his son, O Agni, Vadhryasva bare thee in his lap and served thee.
paragraphs.original: पितेव पुत्रमबिभरुपस्थे त्वामग्ने वध्र्यश्वः सपर्यन् ।
paragraphs.translit: piteva putramabibharupasthe tvāmagne vadhryaśvaḥ saparyan |

paragraphs.text: Thou, Youngest God, having enjoyed his fuel, didst vanquish those of old though they were mighty.
paragraphs.original: जुषाणो अस्य समिधं यविष्ठोत पूर्वाँ अवनोर्व्राधतश्चित्
paragraphs.translit: juṣāṇo asya samidhaṃ yaviṣṭhota pūrvām̐ avanorvrādhataścit

paragraphs.text: 11. Vadhryasva's Agni evermore hath vanquished his foes with heroes who had pressed the Soma.
paragraphs.original: शश्वदग्निर्वध्र्यश्वस्य शत्रून्नृभिर्जिगाय सुतसोमवद्भिः ।
paragraphs.translit: śaśvadagnirvadhryaśvasya śatrūnnṛbhirjigāya sutasomavadbhiḥ |

paragraphs.text: Lord of bright rays, thou burntest up the battle, subduing, as our help, e'en mighty foemen.
paragraphs.original: समनं चिददहश्चित्रभानोऽव व्राधन्तमभिनद्वृधश्चित्
paragraphs.translit: samanaṃ cidadahaścitrabhāno'va vrādhantamabhinadvṛdhaścit

paragraphs.text: 12. This Agni of Vadhryasva, Vrtra-slayer, lit from of old, must be invoked with homage.
paragraphs.original: अयमग्निर्वध्र्यश्वस्य वृत्रहा सनकात्प्रेद्धो नमसोपवाक्यः ।
paragraphs.translit: ayamagnirvadhryaśvasya vṛtrahā sanakātpreddho namasopavākyaḥ |

paragraphs.text: As such assail our enemies, Vadhryasva, whether the foes be strangers or be kinsmen.
paragraphs.original: स नो अजामीँरुत वा विजामीनभि तिष्ठ शर्धतो वाध्र्यश्व
paragraphs.translit: sa no ajāmīm̐ruta vā vijāmīnabhi tiṣṭha śardhato vādhryaśva
